summary: Spawned in the Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG across Level 0, The Hub, the Bonus mall and authored destinations including Level 325: Boom Town. Character progression, inventory and appearance persist in player.state; Solo and Multiplayer keep separate mode/run state, and a brand-new player now opens in a solo laundromat cutscene before the tutorial. The main story is disabled globally while reusable place, combat, quest and creator systems remain in the tree.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes and anomalies; a walk-through Bonus Rooms door is north of the waking point in x0z0.

places/bonus + places/testlab (3D) - vaporwave mall, shops, homes, atlas Teleport Station, interactive props and creator/body fixtures; Bonus sim adds mirror-ball lights, fountain ring, drifting dust and spray.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads and Camp Amber; sim/helpers compose doors, destinations, crews and local interactions.
places/intake + places/laundromat + places/tutorial0 (3D; laundromat and tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation, laundromat opening, waking and staged tutorial office route.
places/level1, level1c, level2, level21, level26 (3D) - procedural halls, camps, pipe halls, locked storage and authored levels.

places/level4, level5, level9, level10, level11, level12, level61, level70 (3D) - offices, hotel, cave, farm, city and Froidetown; Level 11 includes Sedco/Base Beta content and the scaffold-site crossing to Boom Town.
places/level325 (3D) - dark seeded city grid with coordinated tower collapse/salvage, Facelings, story camps/field notes and street-prop kit; quest, life, links and sound layers compose its sim.
places/level114, level27, gamma, level169, level132, level178, level31 and remaining places/* (3D) - authored destinations and local quests/setpieces; several use awakening lighting.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer/player entry, camera and ordered player behavior/actions; locomotion, interaction, combat, social, quests and other systems attach here.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/lib/run-opts.js - per-player arrival, fresh-character and mode/run routing; main-menu-ui.js renders title/pause and expedition settings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, static placements and generation/tick behavior; sims also run environmental and sign/surface passes.
places/level325/config.yaml + scripts/terrain325.js - seeded Boom Town height/material generator; places/level325/sim.js streams tower forms, collapse and street dressing around players.
places/level325/sim.js + scripts/lib/level325-{quest,life,links,sound}.js - tower-cycle controller delegates quest/salvage, Faceling, travel-link and ambient-sound layers.
places/level169, level132, level178 configs/sims + terrain scripts and local helpers - seeded terrain and authored setpieces, town schedules/barter, Kyoto residents and house quest.
places/laundromat/config.yaml + cells/x0z0.scene; scripts/laundromat-geo.js + scripts/lib/laundromat-cut.js - static room/appliances and the player-specific opening sequence before tutorial0.

mods/modeling-studio, mods/advanced-transform, mods/held-gizmo and mods/bodyworks - creator UI, transforms/posing and garment fitting/export; art/cat-wardrobe/body-relax.py and face-relax.py are Blender mesh-edit tools.
shared: scripts/lib/level325.js + scripts/lib/l325-hazard.js - Boom Town grid/tower clock, deterministic stages, zones and hazard/cover queries; terrain, sim, player zone resolver, Facelings and damage handling reuse them.
scripts/lib/boom-quest.js - Ground Rent quest definition shared by Level 11's quest/dialogue handler and Boom Town links.
scripts/quest-prop-use.js - shared quest-prop interaction handler; Level 325 field notes record/read pages alongside Level 3, 6 and 11 quest props.
scripts/lib/places.js - canonical place names/labels/HUD titles and valid atlas destinations; consumed by feed, quests and scripts/ui.js.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/cache/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 adapters.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js + scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js + wardrobe/face data - shared player/NPC cat bodies, outfits, hair, face and eye rendering; NPC face variety is seeded.
scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - Bonus solo/multiplayer routing, home/atlas eligibility and Hub tunnel/door key registry.
scripts/lib/mp-guard.js - multiplayer-room detection, NPC nonlethal down rule, solo permanent-death marking and shootable-hostile classification; scripts/player.js and scripts/meg-agent.js invoke it.
notableExports: scripts/lib/level325.js - CELL/grid constants, cellInfo, clock/keepClock, towerAt, nudge, lobe/hazardAt/coverAt, zoneAt and L325_NAMES; scripts/terrain325.js - heightAt, materialAt.
scripts/lib/level325-quest.js - V, Q325, step325, lay, tick; lays story-note sites and moving salvage heaps.
scripts/lib/boom-quest.js - BOOM (Ground Rent quest key, steps, tips and marks); scripts/l11-site-noclip.js - onTriggerEnter.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - DIRS, createGridPather; places/level10/sim.js and places/level21/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/lib/companion.js - PERKS, perkOf, isMine, followersOf, loyaltyScale, whyNot, recruit/adopt/dismiss/order, weapon handoff, tick, bring; carry.js - carryAcross.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.
scripts/lib/laundromat-cut.js - lmTick; scripts/laundromat-geo.js - geometry, collider; scripts/bonus-door-geo.js - geometry, collider; scripts/bonus-door.js - onTriggerEnter.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable character player.state: progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance, currency and gear shared across Solo/Multiplayer.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/lib/progression.js migrates progression; modifiers, clothes and manuals data/scripts own effects and learned skills.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - mode/run picks; run/quest/story/resume keys swap per mode through SQL slots 91/92 while character and gear remain player.state.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - named save-slot snapshots and hidden Solo/Multiplayer mode snapshots; live character state remains player.state.
scripts/main-menu.js writes solo run.needs/run.sanity survival switches (and fills hunger/thirst when needs are disabled); scripts/player.js applies sanityMul and food/water drain rules.
scripts/lib/hub.js noteAtlas, called by scripts/player.js on arrival - player.state.atlas first-seen dates/visit counts; place sims own local texV/signTexV completion stamps.
scripts/quest-prop-use.js and level quest layers own player.state clue/quest flags; Level 325 owns l325 salvage/scrap progress; page IDs and current reading are player.state.pages/reading.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/lib/laundromat-cut.js - opening progression flags lmDone/arrivePending, skip timing and session cutscene/light/sound state; scripts/lib/mp-guard.js owns place.state.npcPerm and per-player npcDead reports for permanent solo deaths.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered player behavior stack for locomotion, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest, CCTV, radio, barter and phone; scripts/interact.js dispatches focused interactions.
scripts/fall-guard.js holds velocity across place changes for ground streaming; grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; player.js builds viewmodel/avatar through critter-model appearance builders.

Fresh player detected by scripts/main-menu.js → cross to solo places/laundromat; main-menu loads scripts/lib/laundromat-cut.js lmTick, which plays the rain/dryer/lights/fall opening and crosses to tutorial0; jump/main-menu skips it.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; player update calls clockHeal on arrival.
scripts/main-menu-ui.js renders Continue/Start and mode/run/save/settings links; title/pause actions → scripts/main-menu.js, which routes starts/mode picks and applies solo needs/sanity switches.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js mpRoom(party/user) → scripts/lib/hub.js toSolo → party room mp-<party> (or user room); scripts/bonus-door.js onTriggerEnter → toHub for the Level 0 Bonus door; thresholds call carryAcross for held props/followers.

scripts/lib/mp-guard.js multiRoom/soloPlace → scripts/player.js damage and scripts/meg-agent.js death handling: multiplayer friendly NPCs are downed and recover; solo NPC deaths persist and scripts/lib/quests.js deadCheck fails quests tied to them.

scripts/player.js zone resolver → player.state.zone; scripts/lib/places.js → feed, quest labels and scripts/ui.js HUD titles/markers/compass; arrival → hub.noteAtlas writes player.state.atlas for Bonus Teleport Station.

Level 325 world.state.l325 clock + cell hashes → level325.js towerAt → places/level325/sim.js streams towers and collapse; l325-hazard handles impacts, quest layer lays salvage/story camps, scripts/l325-salvage.js grants per-player scrap progress.

Level 325 field-note E → scripts/quest-prop-use.js records page IDs in player.state.pages and sets reading → scripts/ui.js loads scripts/lib/data/pages.yml; supply containers from level325-quest yield backpacks/crates and supplies.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js noStory() → scripts/main-menu.js clears inherited main quest rows and scripts/lib/quests.js blocks new main rows; optional story files remain in the tree but are not an active main-story route.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes table and fitted chairs with paired orientations.

scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + ballistics.js + knock.js + loot.js - weapon variants share combat and rarity/level gates; weights and upgrade rolls vary by level; Boom Town maul/crossbow use fitted models and two-hand grips.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.
scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.
scripts/lib/sleep.js + scripts/interact.js + scripts/rest.js + scripts/l178-prop.js - common bed detection/entry, with ordinary rest and Kyoto futon crossing as distinct outcomes.
scripts/lib/l169-road.js + l169-road-geo.js + l169-travel.js + l169-door.js - checkpoint structures vary by site and geometry kind; streamed props include route boards and animated doors.

places/level132/sim.js + l132-{stalls,shops,land,people,duke,quests,barter}.js + barter-deal.js - staged town and keeper trades use eight goods categories; first gift then balanced currency-free barter.

places/level325/sim.js loads l325-kit-tower, bamboo, rubble, street and base kits into shared piece sync; tower stage/distance vary full, near and far geometry, and collapse tweens move sections into flattened rubble.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists; Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js + scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/lib/data/l178-skins.json - slot-to-texture skin table has no current consumer; x0z0.scene carries material overrides inline.
migrationNotes: Solo and Multiplayer share one character but not run/story state: scripts/lib/run-opts.js isStoryKey defines the swapped key family; MODE_SLOT 91/92 are separate SQL snapshots and hidden from ordinary Save Manager slots.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js noStory() currently returns true in every mode; main-menu sweeps inherited main quest rows from quests/qtrack, and quests.setQuest refuses main rows. Side quests remain separate.
Fresh-player opening chain is main-menu → laundromat → tutorial0; lmDone/arrivePending are player.state flags, while lmSkip and cut timing are session state. The laundromat place is solo/ephemeral.

scripts/lib/mp-guard.js distinguishes multiplayer nonlethal downs from permanent solo NPC deaths; solo permanence is place.state.npcPerm and per-player npcDead drives quest failure, while temporary NPC return timing is scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js via data/meg.yml.
Level 0's Bonus door is a trigger at x=2.5, z=-7.7 in places/main/cells/x0z0.scene and routes through scripts/bonus-door.js → hub.toHub; keep geometry, glow/sign and trigger aligned when moving it.

Level 325 tower stages derive from rebased shared world.state.l325 clock plus deterministic cell hashes; collapse phase state lives in place.state.l325ev. The warning shake ends before the fall tween so it cannot pin sections in place.
